quests.question: This person films themselves talking about things they enjoy.
quests.hint: This person films themselves talking about things they enjoy.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a vlogger. Vloggers record videos to share stories and ideas online.
quests.funFact: Some vloggers share videos with viewers all around the world.
quests.wordExample: The vlogger edited the video before sharing it online.

quests.question: This person brings packages straight to your front door.
quests.hint: This person brings packages straight to your front door.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a delivery driver. Delivery drivers bring packages straight to your front door.
quests.funFact: A delivery driver might drop off hundreds of packages in one day!
quests.wordExample: The delivery driver left a package on our porch.

quests.question: This person performs amazing tricks that surprise everyone.
quests.hint: This person performs amazing tricks that surprise everyone.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a magician. Magicians perform amazing tricks that surprise and delight audiences.
quests.funFact: Some magicians never reveal how their tricks really work.
quests.wordExample: The magician amazed the crowd with a card trick.

quests.question: This person edits videos before sharing them with viewers.
quests.hint: This person edits videos before sharing them with viewers.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a vlogger. Vloggers record videos to share stories and ideas online.
quests.funFact: A vlogger might film and edit a video for hours before sharing it!
quests.wordExample: The vlogger filmed a video about her trip.

quests.question: This person drives from house to house dropping off boxes.
quests.hint: This person drives from house to house dropping off boxes.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a delivery driver. Delivery drivers bring packages straight to your front door.
quests.funFact: Delivery drivers check the address carefully before every delivery.
quests.wordExample: The delivery driver rang the doorbell and waved.

quests.question: This person takes care of animals when they are sick or hurt.
quests.hint: This person takes care of animals when they are sick or hurt.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a vet. Vets take care of sick or hurt animals.
quests.funFact: Vets learn about many different animals, not just cats and dogs.
quests.wordExample: The vet gently checked the bird's wing.

quests.question: This person melts and shapes wax into candles.
quests.hint: This person melts and shapes wax into candles.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a candle maker. Candle makers melt and shape wax into candles.
quests.funFact: A candle maker can add hundreds of different scents to wax!
quests.wordExample: The candle maker poured warm wax into a mold.

quests.question: This person checks the address before leaving a package at the door.
quests.hint: This person checks the address before leaving a package at the door.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a delivery driver. Delivery drivers bring packages straight to your front door.
quests.funFact: A delivery driver might drop off hundreds of packages in one day!
quests.wordExample: The delivery driver left a package on our porch.

quests.question: This person bakes fresh bread and cakes early in the morning.
quests.hint: This person bakes fresh bread and cakes early in the morning.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a baker. Bakers bake fresh bread, cakes, and pastries.
quests.funFact: A baker can turn simple flour and water into warm, fresh bread!
quests.wordExample: The baker decorated the birthday cake with icing.

quests.question: This person adds scents and colors to make pretty candles.
quests.hint: This person adds scents and colors to make pretty candles.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a candle maker. Candle makers melt and shape wax into candles.
quests.funFact: Candle makers carefully pour warm wax into molds to shape it.
quests.wordExample: The candle maker added a sweet scent to the candle.

quests.question: This person does experiments to learn how the world works.
quests.hint: This person does experiments to learn how the world works.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a scientist. Scientists ask questions and do experiments to learn how the world works.
quests.funFact: Scientists sometimes repeat the same experiment many times to be sure of the answer.
quests.wordExample: The scientist mixed two liquids to see what would happen.

quests.question: This person drives a very fast car around a race track.
quests.hint: This person drives a very fast car around a race track.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a race car driver. Race car drivers race fast cars around a track.
quests.funFact: Race car drivers train for years to react quickly at high speed.
quests.wordExample: The race car driver crossed the finish line first.

quests.question: This person pours warm wax into molds to make candles.
quests.hint: This person pours warm wax into molds to make candles.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a candle maker. Candle makers melt and shape wax into candles.
quests.funFact: A candle maker can add hundreds of different scents to wax!
quests.wordExample: The candle maker poured warm wax into a mold.

quests.question: This person wears safety goggles and mixes things in a lab.
quests.hint: This person wears safety goggles and mixes things in a lab.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a scientist. Scientists ask questions and do experiments to learn how the world works.
quests.funFact: A scientist's most important tool is asking good questions!
quests.wordExample: The scientist wrote down everything she noticed in her notebook.

quests.question: This person sits in the front of the airplane and flies it.
quests.hint: This person sits in the front of the airplane and flies it.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a pilot. Pilots fly airplanes and take passengers to faraway places.
quests.funFact: Pilots learn to read many dials and screens before they can fly.
quests.wordExample: The pilot flew the airplane smoothly through the clouds.

quests.question: This person moves gracefully to music on a stage.
quests.hint: This person moves gracefully to music on a stage.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a dancer. Dancers move to music to tell a story or share a feeling.
quests.funFact: Dancers practice for years to make hard moves look easy.
quests.wordExample: The dancer spun gracefully across the stage.

quests.question: This person asks questions and tests ideas to find answers.

quests.funFact: Scientists sometimes repeat the same experiment many times to be sure of the answer.
quests.wordExample: The scientist mixed two liquids to see what would happen.

quests.question: This person helps you learn to read, write, and count at school.
quests.hint: This person helps you learn to read, write, and count at school.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a teacher. Teachers help children learn new things every day.
quests.funFact: Many teachers keep a colorful classroom full of books and posters.
quests.wordExample: The teacher wrote the new words on the board.

quests.question: This person practices steps and jumps to perform a dance.
quests.hint: This person practices steps and jumps to perform a dance.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a dancer. Dancers move to music to tell a story or share a feeling.
quests.funFact: Some dances tell an entire story without using any words at all!
quests.wordExample: The dancer practiced her steps every afternoon.

quests.question: This person creates stories and poems for people to read.
quests.hint: This person creates stories and poems for people to read.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a writer. Writers create stories, poems, and articles for people to read.
quests.funFact: A writer might imagine a whole new world before writing a single word!
quests.wordExample: The writer finished a new chapter of her story.

quests.question: This person performs flips, jumps, and balances.
quests.hint: This person performs flips, jumps, and balances.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a gymnast. Gymnasts perform flips, jumps, and balances that take years of practice.
quests.funFact: Gymnasts practice the same flip hundreds of times to make it perfect.
quests.wordExample: The gymnast balanced carefully on the beam.

quests.question: This person tells a story just by moving to music.
quests.hint: This person tells a story just by moving to music.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a dancer. Dancers move to music to tell a story or share a feeling.
quests.funFact: Dancers practice for years to make hard moves look easy.
quests.wordExample: The dancer spun gracefully across the stage.

quests.question: This person types or writes new words to tell a story.
quests.hint: This person types or writes new words to tell a story.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a writer. Writers create stories, poems, and articles for people to read.
quests.funFact: Some writers write early in the morning when their ideas feel freshest.
quests.wordExample: The writer read the first page of his new book aloud.

quests.question: This person takes care of children while their parents are away.
quests.hint: This person takes care of children while their parents are away.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a babysitter. Babysitters take care of children while their parents are away.
quests.funFact: Babysitters make sure children eat, play, and get to bed on time.
quests.wordExample: The babysitter played a fun game with the children.

quests.question: This person keeps thousands of books neatly organized on shelves.
quests.hint: This person keeps thousands of books neatly organized on shelves.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a librarian. Librarians help people find and borrow books at the library.
quests.funFact: Many librarians organize story time for children at the library.
quests.wordExample: The librarian stamped the return date inside my book.

quests.question: This person imagines a story and then writes it down.
quests.hint: This person imagines a story and then writes it down.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a writer. Writers create stories, poems, and articles for people to read.
quests.funFact: A writer might imagine a whole new world before writing a single word!
quests.wordExample: The writer finished a new chapter of her story.

quests.question: This person checks your teeth and helps keep your smile healthy.
quests.hint: This person checks your teeth and helps keep your smile healthy.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a dentist. Dentists check and clean teeth to keep your smile healthy.
quests.funFact: A dentist can count how many teeth you have in just a minute!
quests.wordExample: I visit the dentist every year for a check-up.

quests.question: This person can help you find the perfect book to read.
quests.hint: This person can help you find the perfect book to read.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a librarian. Librarians help people find and borrow books at the library.
quests.funFact: A librarian can help you find one book among thousands on the shelves!
quests.wordExample: The librarian helped me find a book about dinosaurs.

quests.question: This person decorates chocolates with care in a candy shop.
quests.hint: This person decorates chocolates with care in a candy shop.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a chocolatier. Chocolatiers make delicious chocolate treats by hand.
quests.funFact: A chocolatier can shape melted chocolate into hundreds of tiny treats!
quests.wordExample: The chocolatier melted chocolate to make sweet treats.

quests.question: This person brings your food and drinks to your table.
quests.hint: This person brings your food and drinks to your table.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a waiter. Waiters bring food and drinks to your table at a restaurant.
quests.funFact: Waiters often carry several plates balanced on one arm.
quests.wordExample: The waiter wrote down our order carefully.
